content: Implement the W0122 runtime-owned lifecycle coordinator and neutral memfd/cdev/vfio mirror callback fixture without changing the frozen M0110 descriptors, UAPI, or BAR layout; prove generation/epoch retirement, loss, recovery, idempotence, and pre-commit failure behavior with focused tests.

Content revision 3e89434af6fae4d52b4c7cfdbac20c602fdd1a2d implements the runtime lifecycle coordinator, intermediate mirror stages, candidate high-water reservation, identity-record binding, epoch retirement, request replay/conflict handling, tombstones, and bounded memfd/cdev/vfio-user callbacks. The focused lifecycle test passed; the full dev CTest passed 75/75, including component graph and W0121 model gates.

Content revision f5cdee3e4d8bef41da3d67672057b3fb3fddac3d connects the concrete C++ cdev worker and vfio-user server mirrors to the runtime lifecycle coordinator without changing generated transport records, frozen descriptors, base UAPI, or BAR layout. cdev reset/loss tests passed with retired-generation and DEVICE_LOST completion checks; vfio-user reset advanced generation/epoch and stale DMA map rejection passed. Focused cdev/vfio tests passed 2/2, full dev CTest passed 75/75, component graph passed 17 components/20 edges, and agent records passed. W0122 remains active for memfd integration, QMP/disconnect/restart normalization, provider freeze, failure injection, and qualification.

Content revision 1dbc571f5e44500d1d5c14492fab503683634b7 implements the memfd fallback worker lifecycle mirror and registers the existing C17 fast path as its client half. The adapter stages coordinator-issued identity/generation/epoch candidates, rejects stale submissions, quiesces and drains in-flight work before commit, and preserves lost/absent generations without publishing replacement identity. The focused memfd lifecycle test passed; full development CTest passed 76/76; transport schema passed 5 definitions/15 records; component graph passed 19 components/22 edges; skill routing passed 89 cases; commit identity is Agent Harness (codex). W0122 remains active for production worker wiring, QMP/disconnect/restart normalization, provider freeze, fault injection, and qualification.

The memfd target is intentionally a lifecycle adapter fixture: it does not add a second ring/UAPI or claim M0120 qualification. The C17 client remains runtime/client/fastpath; production memfd worker integration, source normalization, provider enumeration freeze, repeated-cycle and fault evidence remain unresolved under W0122/W0123.

Content revision 71956ff3e4c6d15a1b19b3f6c2e6b386b74f4d4d adds the stateless lifecycle RequestNormalizer and typed ExternalEventKind mapping for admin, VFIO-user, QMP, disconnect, and daemon-restart sources. The normalizer rejects unknown kinds and malformed envelopes without allocating identity or changing Coordinator state. Focused lifecycle tests passed 2/2; full development CTest passed 77/77; transport schema passed 5 definitions/15 records; component graph passed 19 components/22 edges; skill routing passed 89 cases; commit identity is Agent Harness (codex). Producer call-site wiring and QMP command/event correlation remain open.

The normalizer is a boundary contract and test fixture only. It intentionally does not synthesize missing generation, epoch, daemon-incarnation, or request IDs; each external producer must supply the captured tuple and submit the resulting Request to Coordinator. No lifecycle schema or M0110 transport record changed.

Content revision 5e1c3bc49d7d2e83ccab079ebeb99dacdd8679d4 adds a vfio-user QMP command/event correlation fixture. It permits one pending command, requires matching device-added/device-deleted events, maps failed removal to the existing QMP transport-loss request, and emits no add request on failed addition. The focused QMP/lifecycle regression passed 3/3; full development CTest passed 78/78; transport schema passed 5 definitions/15 records; component graph passed 19 components/22 edges; skill routing passed 89 cases; commit identity is Agent Harness (codex). Live QMP socket, producer call-site, production memfd, provider-freeze, fault, and qualification gates remain open.

The QMP adapter is deliberately a cold-control correlation fixture, not a socket implementation or lifecycle authority. It retains the captured request tuple, never allocates generation or epoch, and leaves Coordinator submission to the future producer integration.

Content revision 04ecf81f3be5099451012849b7a064ab2863b9b1 adds the single runtime lifecycle ingress. It normalizes an ExternalEvent, submits only accepted requests to Coordinator, preserves the captured identity/generation/epoch tuple, and returns malformed/unsupported results before authority state changes. The focused lifecycle dispatch selection passed 3/3; full development CTest passed 79/79; transport schema passed 5 definitions/15 records; component graph passed 19 components/22 edges; skill routing passed 89 cases; commit identity is Agent Harness (codex). Source-specific producer wiring, live QMP/socket integration, production memfd, provider-freeze, fault, and qualification gates remain open.

The ingress is intentionally a stateless runtime boundary, not a source adapter. It does not synthesize request IDs, daemon incarnations, generations, epochs, deadlines, or provider state; external producers remain responsible for capturing and validating those fields before submission.
